name: What types of storm damage are most common for homes in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: What types of storm damage are most common for homes in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, including communities like Aurora, Centennial, and Parker, severe hail, high winds, and heavy snowstorms frequently cause roof leaks that lead to ceiling drywall collapse, damaged insulation, and ruined baseboards. Wind-driven rain can push moisture past siding into exterior wall cavities, degrading framing and interior drywall. Because local freeze-thaw cycles and rapid weather shifts can worsen minor water leaks quickly, addressing interior drywall, framing, and finish trim repairs promptly prevents long-term moisture damage to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Denver-area homes frequently suffer interior ceiling leaks, ruined drywall, and damaged trim caused by severe hail, heavy spring snow, and wind-driven rain.
